tasks.label: Build
tasks.detail: Compile the extension host and the webview bundle

tasks.label: Watch
tasks.detail: Rebuild host and webview on change, for F5 development

tasks.label: Test: extension host
tasks.detail: Run the vscode-test suite in a real extension host

tasks.label: Test: webview
tasks.detail: Run the vitest suite for the React surfaces

tasks.label: Verify
tasks.detail: Types, lint, both bundles and both test suites. The release gate.

tasks.label: Release: package VSIX
tasks.detail: Verify, then build porcelain-<version>.vsix in the repo root

tasks.label: Release: publish to Open VSX
tasks.detail: Publish the packaged VSIX. Needs OVSX_PAT in the environment.

tasks.label: Release: publish to VS Code Marketplace
tasks.detail: Local publish with VSCE_PAT in the environment. The normal route is the tag-driven release workflow; see the README.

tasks.label: Open VSX: create namespace
tasks.detail: One time only, before the first publish. Needs OVSX_PAT.

tasks.label: Open VSX: verify token
tasks.detail: Check OVSX_PAT can publish to the namespace, without publishing
